name: Dabao Open Hardware Hackathon
description:
CrossBar hosts the Dabao Open Hardware Hackathon in Mumbai on Thursday and Friday, November 5-6, 2026. The 24-hour hardware and firmware sprint challenges engineers to build cryptographic security applications on open-source silicon.

## What to expect

Participants receive hardware kits featuring the Dabao RISC-V open evaluation board and Daric security chip:
- 24 hours of collaborative prototyping, firmware programming, and hardware integration.
- Mentorship from CrossBar's silicon architects, cryptographic engineers, and embedded systems veterans.
- Hackathon tracks covering hardware authenticator keys, physical unclonable function (PUF) biometric sensors, offline multi-party computation signers, and supply-chain verification tooling.
- Final live demonstrations before a judging panel, with cash prizes and grant opportunities for winning projects.
- Fully catered meals, energy drinks, and hardware debugging stations with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.

## Who should attend

The hackathon is ideal for embedded systems programmers, C/Rust firmware developers, hardware engineers, electrical engineering students, and cybersecurity researchers.

## Venue and schedule

The hackathon takes place at a dedicated maker space in Mumbai, starting at 10:00 IST on Thursday, November 5, and concluding with presentations at 14:00 IST on Friday, November 6.

## Registration and admission

Participation is free with hardware kits provided for all accepted teams. Space is limited to 40 hackers. Apply with your GitHub profile or hardware portfolio to secure a team spot.

name: Bitcoin on Sui: Getting Started with Hashi
description: Bitcoin is the largest pool of idle capital in crypto, and most of it never moves, because using it anywhere else has meant handing it to a custodian or a wrapped-token bridge. Hashi is Sui's answer. Your BTC stays on Bitcoin, held at an address controlled jointly by Hashi's validator committee, which signs with threshold MPC, and an independent guardian layer. Against it, hBTC is minted on Sui and works across Sui apps. Burn the hBTC and the BTC is released back on Bitcoin. Hashi is now live on Sui mainnet in a phased rollout, partners first, backed by more than $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners including Anchorage Digital. In early November about 9.6 hBTC had been minted onchain, and you can watch that number grow. This session explains how Hashi works under the hood and gets you building with it. We read the live mainnet deployment directly: the Hashi object, the deposit and withdrawal queues, the committee and the hBTC supply. Then we use the Hashi TypeScript SDK on testnet with Bitcoin signet to run the full user journey: generate a personal Bitcoin deposit address for a Sui account, send signet BTC to it, follow the deposit through committee approval until hBTC is minted, and request a withdrawal back to Bitcoin. You build hBTC Desk, a small app that runs the testnet round trip and shows the live mainnet numbers beside it. What You'll Learn - How Hashi keeps BTC on Bitcoin: per-account deposit addresses, joint control by the validator committee and the guardian layer, threshold MPC signing, and how hBTC is minted and burned - What is live today: reading the mainnet package, the deposit and withdrawal queues and the hBTC supply with GraphQL, and what a phased rollout means for builders - The SDK: @mysten/hashi, generating a deposit address, submitting a deposit, tracking its status, and requesting or cancelling a withdrawal - Building on hBTC: using it like any other Sui coin in your own Move code and programmable transactions, with 8 decimals and integer base units from end to end - Honest limits: the SDK is pre-1.0 and not yet wired to mainnet, deposits wait for Bitcoin confirmations and a time delay, and how to show pending states so nobody pays twice - How to ship hBTC Desk: deposit signet BTC, watch hBTC arrive on Sui testnet, withdraw back to a Bitcoin address, and compare it with the live mainnet numbers Who Should Attend - DeFi builders who want Bitcoin as collateral in lending, trading or vaults - Wallet and payments teams that want to hold and move BTC inside Sui apps - Developers who joined the bridging and CCTP sessions and want the Bitcoin side of the story - Bitcoin holders curious how BTC can be used on another chain without giving up custody to a single company What to Bring - Laptop with Node.js 22+ and pnpm, and the latest @mysten/sui and @mysten/hashi - A Sui testnet wallet - A Bitcoin wallet that supports signet, such as Sparrow. We share a signet faucet in class - Basic TypeScript. No Bitcoin scripting required Join us at SuiHub to learn, build, and connect with fellow developers pushing the boundaries of the Sui ecosystem.

name: Race Against the Machine: AI, Quantum and the Future of Bitcoin
description:
## Intro

Almost everything we trust online, from banking and web traffic to messaging and digital identity, rests on public-key cryptography. Two threats are now calling that very foundation into question. Quantum computers could break today's signatures and key exchange, with the hardware required shrinking steadily. AI could reach the same result with breakthroughs in mathematics, and it is already helping quantum attacks along by optimizing the circuits behind them.

The synergy between them is unmistakable, and even the post-quantum schemes meant to replace today's cryptography may not be safe either. With finance and the internet facing a long, fragmented migration, the stakes are highest where cryptography protects value directly. Cryptocurrencies add their own exposure: public keys sit on a public ledger, assets are bearer instruments, and theft is irreversible. Given Bitcoin's history, the challenge is particularly acute: every serious option (do nothing, freeze, force a deadline) violates a principle the Bitcoin community cares about, and the work must start before the threat is visible.

Join us at this interdisciplinary event where AI, quantum and Bitcoin experts come together in a novel panel to discuss the technical foundations of this challenge and its potential solutions

Program

17:00 Arrival
17:30 Intro
17:35 Keynote 1: Quantum
17:55 Keynote 2: Bitcoin
18:15 Q&A
19:00 Networkin

name: Whitepaper Reading [SF] - Defi Topics: No Place to Hide & Active Liquidity On Chain
description: Discussion Topics As more trading moves through private RPCs and protected submission channels, the question is how much safety those protections actually buy. No Place to Hide examines three years of activity across six chains and finds sandwich attacks against supposedly protected transactions on four of them. The exposure comes from order-flow auctions, validators, applications, reorgs, and even an RPC bug. We'll ask what "protected" should mean when keeping a trade out of the public mempool still leaves multiple ways for attackers to see it coming, and whether protection can hold without securing the full path from wallet to execution. We'll also cover Active Liquidity On Chain, a study of proprietary AMMs across Solana, Base, and Monad. These venues let a single operator supply inventory and update prices without waiting for a trade, helping them avoid the stale quotes that arbitrageurs exploit in passive AMMs. The paper finds better prices for flow used as a proxy for retail trading, alongside pricing that varies by counterparty and evidence of quotes that worsen at execution. The core discussion is whether tighter spreads justify opaque pricing rules, and how aggregators should route trades when the price they see may differ from the price users receive. Reading Overview - No Place to Hide: Where private transaction protections fail, and what it takes to secure the full path from wallet to execution. - Active Liquidity On Chain: How proprietary AMMs improve pricing, and the trade-offs around transparency, routing, and execution quality. Full Documents - No Place to Hide (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28115) - Active Liquidity On Chain (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38056) Format - 10 minutes of silent reading to start. - Discussion first, with no panels. - Bring questions - technical depth is welcomed. - Short notes and key takeaways shared after the session. About Whitepaper Reading Club Whitepaper Reading Club is a community of 800 builders, founders, and researchers across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Lagos, Bangkok, and New York. The community meets in person every month to discuss the latest blockchain projects. The club creates detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and has held more than 70 sessions since June 2023, covering topics from Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, and EIPs to the Bitcoin ecosystem and AI × crypto. It is ecosystem-agnostic and not for profit, with a strong focus on projects with technical, product, or social innovations. Dimes, our community partner, connects builders with the people, resources, and support to turn ideas into reality. Our host venue, localhost, is Dimes' co-working and event space in downtown San Francisco, created for builders to meet, share ideas, and connect. We're excited to host this event with Whitepaper Reading Club. #Crypto

name: Solana Breakpoint 2026
description:
Solana Breakpoint 2026 is the premier annual conference for the Solana ecosystem, taking place from November 15 to 17, 2026, at Olympia London. Held in the United Kingdom for the first time, Breakpoint brings together more than 8,000 developers, founders, institutional investors, and policymakers representing over 100 countries.

The conference theme, Token Supercycle, centers on the accelerating convergence of traditional finance and high-performance decentralized networks. Key discussion tracks focus on institutional-grade stablecoins, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, high-throughput payments, capital markets infrastructure, and sovereign AI-driven economic agents executing transactions onchain.

Headlining the speaker roster are prominent public leaders and global industry executives, including former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson, former Chancellor of the Exchequer Sajid Javid, Revolut Chair Martin Gilbert, Standard Life Chair Sir Nicholas Lyons, ICE Clear Europe President Hester Serafini, Lord Vaizey, Solana Labs Co-Founder Anatoly Yakovenko, and Solana Foundation President Lily Liu. They are joined by Balaji Srinivasan (Network State), Raoul Pal (Real Vision), Annabel Spring (CEO, Allfunds), Anthony Soohoo (CEO, MoneyGram), and Peter Moore. Official registration offers dedicated tracks for general attendees, developers, and students, surrounded by dozens of community gatherings and side events across London.

name: La Casa de Satoshi cumple 2 años | Lanzamiento oficial del Libro BitcoinCoach
description: ## ¡La Casa de Satoshi cumple dos años! ¿Quieres pagar con Bitcoin? Encontrarás las instrucciones al final de esta página. Para celebrarlo, estamos preparando el evento más grande que hemos organizado hasta ahora: un domingo completo dedicado a la comunidad Bitcoin de México, a las personas que la hacen posible y a los proyectos que están construyendo su futuro. Para esta celebración nos hemos aliado con Rodrigo Coutiño, reconocido autor de libros best seller como MoneyCoach, InvestorCoach y BusinessCoach, para presentar el lanzamiento oficial de su nueva obra: BitcoinCoach. El domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 reuniremos en La Casa de Satoshi a emprendedores, comunidades, empresas, educadores y bitcoiners de todo el país. Será una celebración de todo lo que hemos construido juntos durante estos dos años y, al mismo tiempo, el comienzo de una nueva etapa para La Casa de Satoshi. ## Durante el evento tendremos: El lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach, presentado por su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. Después de la presentación, Rodrigo convivirá con la comunidad y firmará ejemplares del libro. Lightning pitches de proyectos y empresas Bitcoin en México. Hasta diez participantes tendrán entre dos y tres minutos para compartir lo que están construyendo. La historia de La Casa de Satoshi y un anuncio especial sobre su futuro, presentado por Santiago Varela Belmont junto con el equipo de la Casa. ₿ Un anuncio especial de Aureo, presentado por Gustavo Flores Echaiz, seguido del arranque oficial de la fiesta. Una gran parrillada para celebrar el aniversario. Música, convivencia y muchas oportunidades para conocer a las personas que están impulsando Bitcoin en México. ## ¿Qué incluye tu boleto? Un ejemplar de BitcoinCoach de Rodrigo Coutiño, con un precio habitual de $389 MXN en Amazon. Conoce el libro aquí (https://investor.com.mx/bitcoincoach/). Acceso a todas las presentaciones y actividades del programa. Parrillada y bebidas. Si ya has venido a alguna de nuestras fiestas, sabes que se pone bueno. ¡La fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! Maciej Cepnik será el maestro de ceremonias. Este encuentro es para toda la comunidad: quienes han estado con nosotros desde el comienzo, quienes se han sumado durante estos dos años y quienes visitarán La Casa de Satoshi por primera vez. Queremos reunir en un mismo lugar a la comunidad Bitcoin más grande de México para celebrar lo que ya existe, descubrir nuevos proyectos y compartir todo lo que viene. Las empresas, startups y proyectos participantes se anunciarán próximamente. ## Programa preliminar 12:00 p. m. | Apertura de puertas y recepción Registro, convivencia y recepción de asistentes. ¡Llega temprano! Tendremos sorpresas, libros y mucho más para quienes nos acompañen desde el inicio. 1:00-1:30 p. m. | Lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach Presentación del nuevo libro con su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. 1:30-2:00 p. m. | Lightning pitches Hasta diez presentaciones de proyectos, empresas y comunidades que trabajan con Bitcoin en México. Cada participante tendrá entre dos y tres minutos, con breves intervenciones entre las presentaciones. 2:00-2:15 p. m. | La historia y el futuro de La Casa de Satoshi Celebración de los dos años, presentación del equipo y anuncio especial de Santiago Varela Belmont sobre la nueva etapa de La Casa de Satoshi. 2:15-2:30 p. m. | Anuncio especial de Aureo y arranque de la fiesta Presentación de Gustavo Flores Echaiz y apertura oficial de la celebración. A partir de las 2:30 p. m. | Parrillada y fiesta de aniversario Firma de libros y fotografías con Rodrigo Coutiño, música, comida, convivencia y networking con la comunidad. 7:00 p. m. | Cierre del evento Los horarios son aproximados y podrán ajustarse conforme confirmemos a los proyectos, empresas e invitados participantes. La Casa de Satoshi, Ciudad de México Domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 Puertas abiertas desde las 12:00 p. m. Inicio del programa a la 1:00 p. m. Ven a celebrar con nosotros dos años de encuentros, aprendizaje, amistad y construcción comunitaria. ¡Nos vemos en la gran fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! ₿ ## ¿Quieres pagar con Bitcoin? Haz clic en el botón de boletos con Bitcoin y completa tu registro. Después recibirás un correo de maciej@aureobitcoin.com con las instrucciones para realizar tu pago con Bitcoin. Si quieres aprovechar el descuento por pagar con Bitcoin, pero todavía no tienes, visita aureobitcoin.com (https://aureobitcoin.com) para comprar tus primeros bitcoins. ## Patrocinado por Aureo Este evento es patrocinado por Aureobitcoin.com (https://www.aureobitcoin.com/es), la plataforma Bitcoin de México para personas, empresas y patrimonios. name: ¿Qué aporta una Blockchain regulada? - Encuentro #139 SuperPioneros
description:
SuperPioneros - Encuentro #139

 Lunes 16 de noviembre - 17:30h
 Madrid Innovation Lab - Madrid

Durante años hemos hablado de las posibilidades de Blockchain. Pero ahora que empresas, instituciones y desarrolladores empiezan a construir soluciones reales, surge una nueva pregunta:

 ¿Qué aporta realmente una Blockchain regulada frente a otras infraestructuras?

El próximo 16 de noviembre celebramos nuestro Encuentro #139 de SuperPioneros, donde reuniremos a empresas, instituciones, emprendedores y builders para debatir sobre el papel de las nuevas infraestructuras Blockchain L1 reguladas y las oportunidades que abren para el ecosistema.

Y lo haremos junto a ISBE, la iniciativa de Alastria para impulsar una infraestructura Blockchain pública permisionada, diseñada para facilitar el desarrollo de casos de uso empresariales

 LOS PROTAGONISTAS

Contaremos con:

 Miguel Calero, Director Ejecutivo de ISBE, quien compartirá la visión del proyecto, su evolución y las oportunidades que ofrece a empresas y desarrolladores.

 José Luis Cáceres, CEO de NWC10 y SuperPioneros, quien conducirá el encuentro y conectará el debate con los desafíos y oportunidades de nuestra Comunidad.

Próximamente anunciaremos nuevos invitados y empresas con casos de uso reales

 ¿DE QUÉ HABLAREMOS?

Queremos abrir una conversación que vaya más allá de la tecnología.

 Blockchain regulada vs. otras infraestructuras. ¿Qué ventajas ofrece realmente y cuándo tiene sentido utilizarla?

 Empresas e instituciones. ¿Qué necesitan para adoptar Blockchain con confianza y seguridad jurídica?

 Tokenización y nuevos modelos de negocio. ¿Qué oportunidades aparecen para sectores como finanzas, inmobiliario, energía o industria?

 Casos de uso reales. ¿Qué están construyendo las empresas y qué barreras encuentran para llevar sus proyectos a producción?

 Talento y oportunidades. ¿Cómo conectar a las empresas que necesitan soluciones con los builders capaces de desarrollarlas?

No queremos únicamente escuchar presentaciones.

Queremos generar debate, compartir experiencias y descubrir qué podemos construir juntos

 DEL DEBATE A LA CONSTRUCCIÓN

Con Bit2Me como desafío número 1 de SuperPioneros, seguimos impulsando una Comunidad de más de 80.000 innovadores que conecta talento, empresas, instituciones e inversores alrededor de la IA, Blockchain, Web3 y las tecnologías emergentes.

A través de nuestros desafíos 444, queremos ayudar a que las empresas encuentren dentro de la Comunidad los recursos, conocimientos y conexiones necesarios para avanzar hacia sus objetivos durante los próximos cuatro meses.

Y este encuentro representa una oportunidad para conectar infraestructuras como ISBE con empresas que tienen necesidades reales y builders que quieren construir soluciones.

Porque el futuro de Blockchain no dependerá únicamente de la tecnología.

Dependerá de los problemas que seamos capaces de resolver con ella.

name: SC Ventures Lab Crawl Panel 4: Policy Rewiring: When AI Moves Money
description:
About Event AI agents are no longer just recommending payments. With stablecoins and programmable rails, they can initiate and settle them too. That raises questions existing rules weren't written for. What should an agent be allowed to do on its own, when does a human need to approve, and who is accountable when something goes wrong? This session brings together banking, blockchain and regulatory perspectives to look at the permissions, oversight and safeguards needed before agents can be trusted to move real value. On th

:
- - From recommend to execute: what changes when an AI agent can actually move money - Delegated authority: spending limits, approved counterparties and the thresholds that should trigger human approval - Know your agent: how agents are identified, authenticated and tied back to the person or business they act for - When things go wrong: liability for errors, fraud or a compromised agent, and what happens when a stablecoin transaction can't be reversed - Compliance by design: building sanctions screening, AML checks and audit trails into the transaction itself - Are current rules fit for purpose, or does agentic finance need a new rulebook? Speakers: - Rohan Juneja, Product Director, Digital Assets, Standard Chartered Bank - Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business, Polygon - Grace Chong, Head, Financial Services Regulation, Drew & Napier - Kenneth Bok, Director, Digital Assets, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event. name: Digital Assets Developments & Opportunities
description:
Two-Part Programme for Private Bankers and Family Office Practitioners in Asia Format: Two sessions of 90 minutes each The programme moves from "what's changing" to "what to do about it." Singapore and Hong Kong are the anchors, as the main booking centres and family office hubs for this audience, with Japan, the Gulf and other markets brought in where they matter to Asian clients

Part 1: The Global Tokenisation Landscape Title: From Pilot to Production: Markets, Infrastructure and Regulation in 2026 and beyond Tokenisation is moving from pilot projects into regulated commercial activity across several jurisdictions, marking an important inflection point for digital assets in 2026. With Singapore and Hong Kong serving as key financial and family office hubs in Asia, developments in tokenised real-world assets, stablecoins and financial market infrastructure are creating new opportunities and considerations for financial institutions, private bankers, family offices and investors. RHTLaw Asia invites you to join our industry and legal experts as we examine the global tokenisation landscape, focusing on the transition from experimentation to commercial implementation, and the regulatory, market and legal developments shaping its future

Key Discussion Topics 1. Global Policy Developments: The Industry View An examination of regulatory and policy developments across the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE, including stablecoin legislation, tokenised securities and the growing need for cross-border regulatory recognition and interoperable standards. 2. Market and Infrastructure Reality Check A closer look at the rise of tokenised securities and institutional products, including tokenised investment funds and private credit. The discussion will examine infrastructure choices, public versus permissioned blockchains, settlement systems, interoperability risks and the liquidity challenges facing tokenised private assets. 3. Legal Implications for Investors Tokenisation does not change the underlying legal character of an asset. We will examine the distinction between tokens representing direct ownership rights and synthetic exposure, together with the legal considerations and potential risks for issuers and investors. 4. Panel Discussion and Q&A An interactive discussion bringing together industry and legal perspectives on the opportunities and challenges of tokenisation, and what these developments mean for the future of digital assets in Asia

Coming Up: Part 2 - Tokenised Assets: The Investor's Playbook From Insight to Action: Access, Ownership, Risk and Legacy 3 December 2026 | 3:00 pm - 5:00 pm Building on the global developments covered in Part 1, the second session will focus on how private investors and family offices can participate in tokenised assets, including product structures, custody arrangements, investor protection, legal ownership, tax considerations and succession planning. From understanding what's changing to exploring what to do about it. We look forward to welcoming you.

name: Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史
description: English follows Japanese 「あたらしい経済」と「KudasaiJP」が共同運営する企業向けWeb3コミュニティ「Web3 Business Hub（WBH）」では、Web3ビジネスの発展に参考となるセミナーを毎月開催しています。 11月のテーマは「Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史」です。 ブロックチェーンを活用した金融サービスは、BitcoinやEthereumの登場を経て、DEX、レンディング、ステーブルコイン、デリバティブなど、さまざまな領域へと発展してきました。特に2020年のDeFi Summer以降、スマートコントラクトによる金融機能の実装が急速に進み、従来の金融機関や中央集権的な取引所を介さない、新しい金融市場の可能性が示されてきました。 その進化を象徴するプロジェクトの一つが、オンチェーンのデリバティブ取引を中心に成長してきた Hyperliquid です。独自のLayer 1ブロックチェーン上で、高速な取引処理とオンチェーンのオーダーブックを実現し、従来の中央集権型取引所（CEX）に近い取引体験を提供することで、分散型金融の新たな可能性を切り拓いています。さらに、HyperEVMによるアプリケーションの拡張など、単なる取引プラットフォームを超えた金融エコシステムへの発展も注目されています。 一方で、オンチェーン金融の発展には、流動性の確保、価格形成、セキュリティ、分散性、ガバナンス、規制対応など、さまざまな課題も存在します。DeFiはこれまでの歴史の中で何を実現し、何を課題として残してきたのでしょうか。そしてHyperliquidのような新しいプラットフォームは、従来の金融市場や暗号資産取引所のあり方をどこまで変えるのでしょうか。 今回のWeb3 Business Hubでは、DeFiの誕生からDeFi Summer、DEXやオンチェーンデリバティブの進化、そしてHyperliquidの成長に至るまで、オンチェーン金融の歴史を振り返ります。あわせて、Hyperliquidの仕組みや成長の背景、既存の金融サービスとの違い、今後の事業機会と課題についても整理します。 金融サービスは、どこまでオンチェーンで実現できるのか。 Hyperliquidを通じて、オンチェーン金融の現在地と、金融機関・Web3事業者・一般企業にとっての新たな可能性を、ゲストの藤田氏と参加者の皆さまと一緒に考えます。 藤田拓也氏プロフィール Hyperliquid Japan 技術渉外 / SubEtha Founder 筑波大学社会工学類卒。HashHubでブロックチェーンエンジニアとして経験を積み、MycelやHiveFiなどのWeb3プロジェクトに参画。クロスチェーン、DeFi、AI×ブロックチェーン領域の開発に携わり、ETHGlobal、HackAtom、Colosseumなどのハッカソンで受賞。Cosmos JapanのAdminとしてコミュニティ運営に携わり、現在はHyperliquid JapanのAdmin・技術渉外として活動。自ら立ち上げたAIエージェント向けプライバシー決済プロトコル「SubEtha」では、代表としてプロダクト開発を進めている。 セミナー概要 Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史 日時：2026年11月18日（水）19:00 開場／19:30 開始（20:30〜ネットワーキング、21:30 イベント終了予定） 会場：幻冬舎3号館 3F https://www.neweconomy.jp/features/wbh ---- The "Web3 Business Hub (WBH)", a corporate-focused Web3 community jointly operated by Atarashii Keizai and KudasaiJP, hosts monthly seminars designed to provide practical insights for advancing Web3 business initiatives. The theme for October is "Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance" Blockchain-based financial services have evolved significantly since the emergence of Bitcoin and Ethereum, expanding into various areas such as decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending, stablecoins, and derivatives. In particular, since DeFi Summer in 2020, the rapid development of smart contract-based financial applications has demonstrated the potential for new financial markets that operate without relying on traditional financial intermediaries or centralized exchanges. One of the projects representing this evolution is Hyperliquid, which has gained significant attention through its focus on on-chain derivatives trading. Built on its own Layer 1 blockchain, Hyperliquid combines high-speed transaction processing with an on-chain order book, offering a trading experience comparable to that of centralized exchanges (CEXs) while exploring new possibilities for decentralized finance. With the expansion of its ecosystem through HyperEVM, Hyperliquid is also evolving beyond a trading platform into a broader on-chain financial ecosystem. At the same time, the development of on-chain finance continues to face challenges, including liquidity, price discovery, security, decentralization, governance, and regulatory compliance. What has DeFi achieved throughout its history, and what challenges remain unresolved? To what extent can emerging platforms such as Hyperliquid transform traditional financial markets and the role of cryptocurrency exchanges? For this edition of Web3 Business Hub, we will explore the history of on-chain finance, from the early days of DeFi and DeFi Summer to the evolution of DEXs and on-chain derivatives, culminating in the rise of Hyperliquid. We will also examine Hyperliquid's architecture, the factors behind its growth, how it differs from traditional financial services, and the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead. How much of the financial system can ultimately move on-chain? Through the lens of Hyperliquid, we will explore the current state and future potential of on-chain finance, as well as the new opportunities it may create for financial institutions, Web3 businesses, and enterprises. name: Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit 2026
description:
## Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit 2026 Two years ago, the Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit was a closed room. Leaders from circular economies around the world, comparing notes, figuring out together what actually works when you try to make Bitcoin a daily medium of exchange instead of a speculative bet. Quiet work. The kind nobody tweets about while it's happening. On November 19-20, 2026, the Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit becomes a public conference for the first time, and it's happening in El Zonte. Not San Salvador. Not a hotel ballroom somewhere convenient. El Zonte, the same stretch of sand where this whole story started, where people were paying for pupusas and surfboards in sats years before anyone outside the country had heard of Bitcoin Beach. It's the first conference of its kind this town has ever hosted. And there's really only one thing it could be about: Bitcoin is money, and the circular economies are the proof

Two Years of Building Toward This For two Summits, the focus was internal. Builders talking to builders. Communities in El Salvador, Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America, comparing what worked, what failed, what scaled. It turned into a real global conversation, even if most people never saw it happen. The 2026 edition finally opens that conversation to everyone who's been curious from the outside. Leaders, merchants, educators, developers, and honestly, anyone who wants to see what Bitcoin adoption looks like when it's not a headline but a Tuesday afternoon at a market stall

What Two Days Actually Look Like This isn't a stage with slides and a Q&A at the end. It's workshops, panels, and fireside chats built around the questions that actually define where Bitcoin adoption goes next: ● Bitcoin is money: the case from on-the-ground reality● Circular economies: what's working, what's scaling, what's next● Bitcoin for merchants: practical adoption at the point of sale● Education: onboarding the next million users● Adoption: pathways from curiosity to daily use● Tools: the infrastructure powering real-world Bitcoin commerce Every session wraps before sunset. This is El Zonte, after all, and nobody organizing this event forgot that the ocean is right there

Who's Already Confirmed The lineup is still growing, but a few names are already locked in, and they set the tone for what this Summit is actually about: ● Jeremy Almond (@jeremyalmond), Co-Founder & CEO of Paystand● Alexandra Navarro (@alex_navarro0), also from Paystand● Gerardo Linares (@GR_Linares1), driving Bitcoin adoption through education and real-world circular economies with Bitcoin Berlin SV and Bitcoin La Laguna● Evelyn Lemus (@Evelynlemus2906), building and educating communities through the same two projects Not a single one of them is on this list because of a headline they made. They're here because they took Bitcoin out of theory and put it directly into the hands of people who never had financial access before. That's the thread running through this whole event

A Beach, Not a Backdrop Come for the panels, but stay for the reason this movement exists in the first place. You're going to hear it straight from the people who built it: why Bitcoin is money, why it matters for the people who've been failed by every other financial system, and why freedom and fairness aren't abstract words when you've watched them play out in a small coastal town. And between sessions, there's still surf if you want it, there's still that particular warmth of Bitcoin Country that doesn't translate to a conference center anywhere else. This isn't a Bitcoin summit that happens to be near a beach. It only makes sense on this one

November in El Salvador Is Getting Busy This isn't even the only Bitcoin event on the calendar this month, and that alone says something about where this country is right now: ● November 10 - Bitcoin Capital Summit● November 11-12 - Bitcoin Historico, San Salvador● November 18-19 - EmTech AI Conference● November 19-20 - Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit, El Zonte Four events, one month, in a country that used to make headlines for very different reasons. Now it's builders, educators, and investors filling flights to come see what's actually being built here

We're Genuinely Looking Forward to This One Every year this Summit has been a working session behind closed doors. This year, for the first time, everyone gets to be in the room, and that shift feels like a real milestone, not just for the event but for the movement it represents. El Zonte earned this. The people who built circular economies from nothing, in El Salvador and around the world, earned a stage. Seats are limited, and this is the first time El Zonte has hosted anything like it. If you want to hear, in their own words, why Bitcoin is money, this is the place to be

Every SAT count

Bitfest 2026 - The UK's Largest Bitcoin Festival | Manchester Bitfest 2026 - The UK's Largest Bitcoin Festival - About Us - Events - Bitflix - Nostrshire - Hackathon - nPub Dub - Bitfest - Pepe.X - NME Concert - Sunday Social - FULL AGENDA - Get Tickets - Partners - Collaborate - Media - Cinematics - Blog - Gallery - Media Kit - FAQ - Join Us 19 - 22 NOVEMBER 2026 PENDULUM HOTEL, MANCHESTER WHAT IS BITFEST? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival. The 2026 edition is a four-day Bitcoin festival in Manchester, taking place from 19-22 November 2026. It brings together Bitcoiners, builders, communities, artists, families and newcomers for talks, workshops, an expo, art, cinema, gaming, live music, Nostr and freedom technology. So... is it a conference? Well, yes and no. Bitfest is a space where people from all walks of life can come together for a weekend powered by Bitcoiners. It's about community as much as it is about technology: a place to connect, learn, explore, and actually experience Bitcoin culture in action. While talks and panels are part of the programme, Bitfest goes far beyond a traditional conference - incorporating talks, discussions and hands-on workshops covering not just Bitcoin, but other freedom-adjacent topics. Our inaugural event, Bitfest 2025, featured 5 events and 8 themed zones across 3 days, with 60+ speakers and artists, all hosted across multiple nearby venues. And now Bitfest is back for 2026. Bigger, louder and with even more to explore! This year's programme brings together a staggering 8 events and 9 zones, creating an even bigger celebration of Bitcoin, freedom technology, creativity and the communities building the future. Bitfest is designed for everyone - whether you're deep in the space or just getting started. It's family-friendly too and so bring the kids along! Day 0 also features Nostrshire, the UK's first full-scale conference dedicated entirely to Nostr. EVENTS Bitfest isn't just one event - it's a whole weekend of them. From Nostr and Bitcoin conferences to live music, internet culture, social events and everything in between, each event has its own character, community and reason to be here. Explore the events that make up Bitfest 2026. THERE'S MORE TO EXPLORE ZONES Across the festival you'll find nine themed zones, each bringing a different side of Bitcoin and freedom technology to life. From talks and hands-on workshops to gaming, music, art, business and a place for the kids, there's plenty to explore beyond the main stage. CONFERENCE TALKS & PANELS Hear from leading Bitcoin professionals, builders and people advocating for Bitcoin and Nostr. WORKSHOP / HACK ZONE DIY Build, learn and collaborate across two days of workshops, unconference sessions and the Bitfest 2026 Hackathon. Explore the Hackathon EXHIBITION PROJECT AND BUSINESS EXPO Discover and catch up with the latest projects and businesses building on Bitcoin. GALLERY BY PEPE.X BITCOIN ART EXHIBITION A visual celebration of Bitcoin culture, digital art, memes and creative experiments, bringing the weird, wonderful and wildly creative side of the internet into the real world. FREEDOM FEST FREEDOM & SOVEREIGNTY TECH Explore privacy, digital rights, civil liberties and freedom technology through Freedom Fest - a distinct event running alongside Bitfest on Saturday. FREEDOM FEST GAMING GAMES & COMPETITIONS Enter the gaming zone to discover Bitcoin-powered games and participate in competitive gaming sessions. MUSIC NEW MUSIC ECONOMY & VALUEVERSE Entertainment led by musicians utilising New Music Economy tooling in the Valueverse. NETWORKING DRINKS, FOOD & BANTER Mix and mingle networking zones in both the Pendulum Café during the day and The Shack NQ in the evening. KIDS BITCOIN JUNIORS A safe, supervised space for kids to play, create and have fun, with DBS-checked staff so parents can leave them safely and catch a talk, explore the festival or grab a bit of peace and quiet. PRE-PARTY BITFLIX & PRE-EVENT RECEPTION 4:30pm - 1am - 19 NOVEMBER - PENDULUM HOTEL/THE TAP HOUSE Kick off the Bitfest weekend with The Six Billion Dollar Man, Eugene Jarecki's award-winning documentary exploring Julian Assange, WikiLeaks and the price of truth. Fittingly, when traditional gatekeepers blocked the film, it found a route to audiences through the Bitcoin community. Full Bitfest ticket holders can then join our exclusive pre-event drinks reception to meet fellow Bitcoiners and get the weekend started. With 5 events and 8 zones Bitfest was created to be a bastion of Bitcoin education, culture and community for the UK. Bitcoiners together strong! Read More 2025 GALLERY Check out some of the action from Bitfest 2025. SEE MORE FAQ What is Bitfest? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival, bringing together Bitcoin, Nostr, freedom technology, music, art, culture, workshops, gaming, businesses and communities for one packed long weekend in Manchester. When is Bitfest 2026? Bitfest 2026 runs from 19-22 November 2026, with different events taking place across the long weekend. Where is Bitfest? Bitfest's main venue is The Pendulum Hotel in Manchester, with events taking place at nearby venues throughout the weekend. Do I need to know about Bitcoin to attend? Absolutely not. Bitfest is for everyone - from people who have been running nodes for years to people who have only just heard about Bitcoin. Come curious, ask questions and get involved. How do I get to Bitfest? Driving From the North - M6 / M61 Follow the M6/M61 towards Manchester, then join the M60 following signs for Stretford. Take M60 Junction 12 and join the M602 towards Salford/Manchester. At the end of the M602, follow the A57 towards Manchester. Continue onto the A57(M) Mancunian Way and take the second exit, then immediately follow the slip road signed University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is on Sackville Street. From the South & Midlands - M6 Follow the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, taking the A556 towards Manchester. At the Bowdon roundabout, take the third exit onto the M56 towards Manchester Airport/Manchester. Continue to the end of the M56 and follow the A5103 towards Manchester. At the roundabout beneath the road, take the third exit following A57(M) / Sheffield signs, then take the second exit up the ramp onto the A57(M). Take the next exit signed University and immediately fork left onto the slip road for University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is ahead on Sackville Street. From London - M40 / M42 / M6 Follow the M40 north, then the M42/M6 towards Manchester. Continue on the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, then follow the South & Midlands directions above via the A556 and M56. From Manchester Airport - M56 Take the M56 towards Manchester. At the end of the motorway, continue onto the A5103 towards Manchester and follow the same route as above: take the third exit at the roundabout following A57(M) / Sheffield, then the second exit onto the A57(M). Take the next exit signed University and follow the slip road for University/Sackville Street. Public Transport From Manchester Piccadilly: The Pendulum is around a 10-15 minute walk from Manchester Piccadilly station, or a short taxi ride. From Manchester Oxford Road: The Pendulum is only a few minutes' walk from Manchester Oxford Road station. From Manchester Airport: Direct trains run from Manchester Airport to Manchester Piccadilly, normally taking around 20 minutes. From Piccadilly, The Pendulum is a short walk or taxi ride. Manchester is also well connected by rail from cities across the UK, including London, Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool and Sheffield. Is there parking nearby? Yes. There are several car parks within walking distance of The Pendulum, including NCP Circle Square on Oxford Road, which is just a couple of minutes from the hotel. We'll add further details, including any Bitfest/Pendulum parking discounts or codes, here once confirmed. What does my ticket include? There are several ticket options depending on how much of the festival you want to experience. A Full Bitfest Ticket gives you access across the main festival programme and includes the exclusive Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. Can I buy a One Day Pass? Yes. A One Day Pass can be used for Nostrshire on 20 November or Bitfest on 21 November, and includes access to all zones and the relevant afterparty. What is Bitflix? Bitflix is our Bitcoin Film Zone, returning this year as a pre-festival event. It kicks off the festival with a screening of The Six Billion Dollar Man, followed by the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. It's a chance to start the weekend with a great film, good conversation and the wider Bitfest community. Who can attend the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception? The Pre-Event Reception is an exclusive benefit for Full Bitfest Ticket holders. One Day Pass and Afterparty-only tickets do not include access to the reception. Are children welcome at Bitfest? Yes. Bitfest is family-friendly, and children are welcome. For ticketing purposes, a child is anyone under 16. Can I leave my children in the Kids Zone? Yes. The Kids Zone is a supervised play space for children during the festival where they can play safely while parents enjoy the event. It is not intended as a formal childcare or day-care service. The team are DBS checked and appropriate safeguarding procedures are in place. Where can I see the full agenda? The full agenda, including timings, speakers, workshops, performances and other programme details, will be published separately as we get closer to the festival. Can I pay for my ticket with Bitcoin? Yes. Bitfest tickets are available to purchase in Bitcoin or fiat. I've never been to a Bitcoin event before. Will I fit in? Definitely. Bitfest is deliberately broader than a traditional Bitcoin conference. Whether you're a hardcore Bitcoiner, a Nostr user, a builder, artist, musician, entrepreneur, parent or simply curious about what all the fuss is about, you're welcome. Are there any discount codes for accommodation? Yes. We've secured a discounted accommodation rate at The Pendulum Hotel, our main venue in Manchester city centre - Sackville Street, about a 5-minute walk from Piccadilly Station. Book at the Bitfest rate using code BITFEST - Book now. If the Pendulum is full, there are several other hotels within a few minutes' walk of the venue. The closest are the ibis Manchester Centre (Princess Street) and the Maldron Hotel Manchester City Centre, both on Charles Street. Also nearby: Motel One Manchester-Piccadilly, Premier Inn Manchester City (Piccadilly), Travelodge Manchester Piccadilly and Malmaison Manchester. We're still confirming rates and discount codes with other local hotels - anything we secure will be added here. I have a different question. How can I get in contact? Complete the form below and we'll be in touch as soon as possible. REGISTER YOUR INTEREST Register now to join our community and get notified about Bitfest updates! name: REWIRED: A Forum on Stablecoins and Agentic Payments
description:
19 November 2026 -
- 12:30-17:00 SGT - Lunch provided - Approval within 24 hours Feeling lucky? Several Fitbit Air trackers are up for grabs, plus the new Fitbit Edge, launched just weeks ago. Intro This year's Singapore FinTech Festival looks at the forces rewiring global finance. Payments is where that rewiring is most visible: AI agents are starting to spend real money, more of it settles in stablecoins, and the rails are arriving faster than the controls. REWIRED brings together the people building and running payments to work out what comes next: - Who authorises an agent to pay? - What stops the payment when the agent is compromised? - Where does the margin sit when software pays software? Speakers Featuring speakers from AWS, Visa, Mastercard, BVNK, BlockSec, FXC Intelligence, Sunrate and Cobo You make the calls - Run the incident. MAS's SAFR framework proposes that no agent action executes until it has been declared, authorised and assessed. Test that idea on a live case: an agent with payment authority has been manipulated and transfers are queued. Vote on what stops the money, then put the panel on the spot. - Pick the rails. Card networks are piloting agent checkout across APAC, and Visa already settles in stablecoins at a US$7 billion annualised run rate. Cards, stablecoins or both: argue who owns checkout when the buyer is software. - Settle the bank question. Everyone agrees you need a bank to cash out. Beyond that, decide whether banks still own anything when agents pay: programmable money, accountability for the agent, or 24/7 settlement. Ask in English or Chinese on Slido at any time. Who should attend Anyone building, running or investing in payments, stablecoins or AI-driven commerce. Agenda (SGT)
- 12:30 - Check-in, lunch and networking
- 13:30 - Opening remarks, Cobo
- 13:35 - Keynote: Agents Can Hold Wallets. Who Holds the Keys?
- 13:55 - Keynote: From Operator to Supervisor: How AI Agents and Stablecoins Are Rewiring the B2B Treasury
- 14:15 - Keynote: Secure Agents, Smart Payment
- 14:35 - Panel 1, Live Wire: An Agent Goes Rogue Mid-Payment. Who Pulls the Plug?
- 15:05 - Panel 2, Crossed Wires: Cards or Stablecoins? Which Rails Will Agents Pay On?

- 16:05 - Networking

Venue - Where: AWS Office Event Space, Level 5, IOI Central Boulevard Towers, 2 Central Blvd, Singapore 018916 - Entry: Show your Luma ticket and photo ID at building security, then go directly to Level 5 Registration Space is limited and subject to host approval. Requests are usually approved within 24 hours. Request to join, and bring a question worth debating. About Cobo Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Singapore, Cobo builds trusted infrastructure for wallets and payments, serving humans and AI agents. Cobo has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit by a Big Four firm, is ISO 27001 certified, and has secured billions in client assets with zero security incidents since 2017. Learn more at www.cobo.com (https://www.cobo.com). About Sunrate Sunrate is a leading global payment and treasury management platform for businesses worldwide. Founded in 2016, Sunrate has enabled companies to operate and scale both locally and globally in 190+ countries and regions with its cutting-edge infrastructure, global network, and unified solutions. About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the cloud platform of Amazon, providing the infrastructure, data and AI services on which banks, asset managers and hedge funds build and run their research, trading and risk workloads. Financial institutions use AWS to train and deploy AI models securely and at scale. 2026 年 11 月 19 日 -
- 12:30-17:00（新加坡时间）- 提供午餐 - 24 小时内审核 参会还能抽奖？ 多款 Fitbit Air 运动手环以及几周前刚刚发布的全新 Fitbit Edge 等您来拿。 简介 今年的新加坡金融科技节将聚焦重塑全球金融的力量。支付是这种重构最显而易见的领域：AI 智能体正开始进行真实消费，越来越多的交易以稳定币结算，而基础设施的发展速度远超风控机制。 REWIRED 汇聚了支付领域的建设者与运营者，共同探讨未来发展方向： - 谁来授权智能体进行支付？ - 当智能体受到攻击时，由什么来阻止支付？ - 当软件向软件支付时，利润流向何处？ 演讲嘉宾 演讲嘉宾来自 AWS、Visa、Mastercard、BVNK、BlockSec、FXC Intelligence、Sunrate 与 Cobo 由您做决定 - 应对突发事件。 新加坡金管局（MAS）的 SAFR 框架提出，在声明、授权和评估之前，智能体不得执行任何操作。通过真实案例测试该理念：一个拥有支付权限的智能体遭到篡改，转账请求已排队。就如何拦截资金投票，并现场质询嘉宾。 - 选择支付轨道。 卡组织正在亚太地区试点智能体结账服务，Visa 的稳定币结算年化规模也已达 70 亿美元。银行卡、稳定币还是两者结合：辩论当买家是软件时，谁主导结账环节。 - 厘清银行的角色。 大家都认同，将稳定币兑换为现金离不开银行。除此之外，当智能体进行支付时，银行还掌握着什么？可编程货币、为智能体担责，还是全天候结算？ 随时在 Slido 上使用中英文提问。 参会对象 任何从事支付、稳定币或 AI 驱动商业建设、运营或投资的专业人士。 活动议程（新加坡时间）

description: Slow Transaction Data Is Alpha Leakage This session breaks down how delayed, incomplete, or dropped transaction data affects execution, risk, and product experience in fast-moving Solana markets. We'll cover what trading and DeFi teams should evaluate in a real-time data stack, from streaming latency to recovery after disconnects. Alchemy will walk through the infrastructure patterns it sees teams use to keep onchain state current. Attend if you are: Trading firms, market makers, exchanges, DeFi teams, and engineering leaders building real-time Solana applications. Intermediate to advanced. More about the Workshop Leader: Canaan Linder is a prominent tech entrepreneur and product leader currently serving as the Product Lead for Solana at Alchemy, where he drives developer infrastructure solutions for the high-performance blockchain ecosystem. Prior to joining Alchemy, he founded and served as the CEO of Stardust, a leading web3 gaming infrastructure platform that raised millions to streamline multi-chain scaling and wallet management for game creators. An alumnus of Carnegie Mellon University, Linder combines a strong technical foundation with deep expertise in web3, scalable infrastructure, and gaming ecosystem development. name: Bitcoin - Was unser Geld morgen wert ist
description: **Die 7. Females Fit for Finance-Edition hosted by Sara Bratke & Marika Cieslinski** **Thema**: Lerne mit Margot Richter über die Kryptowährung "Bitcoin" und wie du zu deiner finanziellen Souveränität beitragen kannst **Über das Event** Die Möglichkeiten zu investieren und einen Wertspeicher zu finden, sind heute vielfältig und die Flut an Informationen kann schnell überfordern. Aktien, ETFs, Gold, Immobilien und dann gibt es da auch noch Kryptowährungen wie Bitcoin. Margot Richter zeigt, warum Bitcoin für sie ein spannendes Werkzeug ist, um sich als Frau mit finanzieller Unabhängigkeit, Inflation, Altersvorsorge und langfristigem Werterhalt auseinanderzusetzen. Das Event ist kostenlos (wir freuen uns über freiwillige Spenden). **Inhalt des Impuls-Vortrags** Bevor wir uns Bitcoin genauer ansehen, lohnt sich ein Blick auf etwas, das wir täglich verwenden, aber selten hinterfragen: unser Geldsystem. Margot gibt eine kurze Einführung, wie unser heutiges Geld eigentlich funktioniert, wer es beeinflusst und was das für den Wert unseres Geldes in Zukunft bedeutet. Darauf aufbauend führt Margot verständlich in die Welt von Bitcoin ein. Sie erklärt, was Bitcoin ist, was Bitcoin zum souveränen Wertspeicher machen kann und welche Vorteile und Möglichkeiten Bitcoin gegenüber anderen Investments bietet. Der Vortrag richtet sich an Frauen, die bisher wenig oder gar keine Berührung mit Bitcoin hatten und das Thema besser verstehen möchten. **Über Margot Richter** Margot beschäftigt sich seit 2020 intensiv mit Bitcoin, Finanz-und Wirtschaftsthemen. Sie gibt hierzu Einsteigerkurse via der Bildungsplatform "Bitucation", organisiert Bitcoin Veranstaltungen für Frauen und ist in der deutschsprachigen Bitcoin Community sehr engagiert. Sie gründete außerdem den "Bitcoin Book Club". Als ausgebildete Wanderinstruktorin leitet sie ebenfalls Wanderungen in Österreich. Margot arbeitet als selbstständige Physiotherapeutin in Wien. Vernetze dich mit Margot: \- Webseite Bitucation [www.bitucation.com](http://www.bitucation.com/) \- instagram @maggie_rahel \- Telegram @makeitorange96 \- Telegram Gruppe Buchclub [https://t.me/bitcoinbookclub](https://t.me/bitcoinbookclub) \- Telegram Gruppe Wanderungen @21 Million steps to go \- Margots Webseite [www.physiorichter.com](http://www.physiorichter.com/) **Ablauf des Abends** 18:15 Uhr - Ankommen & Netzwerken: bitte kommt rechtzeitig vor Beginn des Vortrages, damit das Ephata-Team genügend Zeit hat, euch kulinarisch zu versorgen. \~ 19:00 Uhr - Impulsvortrag von Margot Richter Interaktive Q&A-Session Austausch und Diskussion unter den Teilnehmerinnen **Anmeldung** Die Veranstaltung ist kostenlos, wir freuen uns über eine freiwillige Kulturspende vor Ort, um unsere Kosten zu decken. Bitte meldet euch über Meetup an - sollte das nicht funktionieren, gerne per E-Mail an femalesfinance@gmx.net. name: Quantum Security for Digital Assets
description:
As quantum computing accelerates toward cryptographically relevant milestones, the digital asset ecosystem faces an architectural reckoning. Public blockchains like Ethereum are charting multi-year post-quantum cryptography (PQC) roadmaps and custody providers are testing PQC in practice, but protecting distributed ledgers, critical infrastructure and cross-border digital economies requires coordinated action across industry, regulators and government agencies. This afternoon brings them into one room. We open with Project Eagle, a live PQC pilot co-led by Safeheron and the Responsible Fintech Institute, in which banks and regulators across multiple jurisdictions test quantum-resistant multi-party computation (MPC) signing on a public testnet. A panel of leaders from law, law enforcement technology, smart-city jurisdictions and quantum security then examines signature scheme migration, systemic risks to custody and key management, and the public-private standards needed before Q-Day. We close with Ethereum's post-quantum roadmap and what it means for institutions, followed by networking. EVENT AGENDA

name: Designing Trust in the Digital Economy
description:
## Introduction As AI reshapes how we build, create, and transact, trust has become the currency that matters most. Join us for an event on using AI to build trust across the new money era, content, and AI itself with keynotes, a hands-on AI skills challenge, and networking to wrap up the evenin

:
- Keynote talks from industry voices Live Q&A with speakers Community networkin

Speakers Peter Zheng is Head of Design at OKX, where his team designs the products more than 120 million customers use to trade, pay and save. Over 20 years, his career has taken him from East to West, through agencies including W+K, TBWA\Media Arts Lab and Ogilvy, and in-house at Google, Samsung and Meta. Working across cultures has taught him that good ideas start with listening. As AI changes how products get made, he is helping his team move from designing screens to designing systems, with people at the center. Topic Intro: More of our financial lives now happen on a phone, at any hour, and soon with AI doing some of the work for us. None of that matters if people don't feel safe enough to use it. Crypto gave us new ways to prove things. Anyone can check a transaction on a blockchain, and exchanges publish reports showing they hold customers' funds. Yet people still hesitate before they hit "confirm." Proof and protection are different things, and design has to close the distance between them. In this session, Peter shares how OKX designs for trust, from showing people how they're protected to helping them understand what they're agreeing to before it's final. He'll also look at what changes when we start handing some of those decisions to an AI agent. Pearly Tan is Content Systems Director at OKX, where she is leading the shift from content design as a service to content as a scalable system for global digital products. She previously led Global Content Design at OKX and led the build of award-winning experiences across Meta Reality Labs, TikTok Shop and Bank of Singapore. Topic intro: As digital products expand, users face more opportunities, choices and information. They also face more uncertainty, emotion and risk. Trust must be built throughout the experience, especially when people are deciding whether to explore, act, or ask for help. Doing this at scale requires a shift from relying on specialists for every decision to building systems that make trustworthy choices easier across the organisation. This session explores how content systems can: - Give users the information they need, when they need it - Build trust with transparency that is relevant and proportionate - Direct expertise to moments where uncertainty carries real consequences - Help every team make sound, responsible decisions at scale Pearly will discuss OKX's content transformation and how AI-enabled systems can help more people become responsible trust builders. Ben Bowes is the Director of Product Design at Open Government Products (OGP), where he helps teams make government products effective, enjoyable and worthy of people's trust. He thinks public service is where the best designers belong, making everyday life better for the people around them. As AI reshapes how we build and create, Ben believes people must remain at the heart of what we design and why. Topic intro: When AI can make almost anything look and sound convincing, how do we know what's real and who to trust? From everyday encounters to government services, design shapes how trust is built, tested and sometimes exploited. With so much uncertainty, how can public institutions earn our trust? Maybe a little doubt is part of what makes trust possible

Who should attend - Designers who are curious about how AI is reshaping trust in technolog

UBC: Where Talent Meets Opportunity

The University Blockchain Conference (UBC) - formerly the Midwest Blockchain Conference - is the leading access point connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry across the U.S. and beyond.

What started in the heartland of Ann Arbor has grown into a national movement and global network, now spanning 100+ universities including schools in South America and Europe. This year, we're evolving - new name, new home, same mission.

Built by students for students, UBC brings together university clubs, high schools, alumni, and industry leaders, all focused on pushing crypto forward through student leadership.

 Connecting Top Talent with Leading Companies

If you're a student or faculty member passionate about blockchain, this is your gateway. This November, connect with dozens of hiring companies, VCs eager to invest, and thought leaders excited to share knowledge with the next generation of builders.

If you're an industry professional, UBC offers unmatched exposure to over 1000+ ambitious students and dozens of elite university programs, many of which have traditionally been difficult to reach. Grow your user base, recruit standout talent, and shape the future of the space.

 Bigger Than Ever - Real Outcomes

UBC 2026 is set to surpass every prior year in every dimension: More speakers. More sponsors. More opportunities.

And it's working. Past attendees landed roles at:
Coinbase, Circle, Gemini, Galaxy, Polymarket, and many leading companies in blockchain, fintech, and policy.

This year, expect world-class speakers from industry and government, a major hackathon and research competition, tons of networking opportunities, massive side events, and as always, fire merch.

 Hosted at The University of Texas at Austin

Set in Austin, one of America's fastest-growing tech and innovation hubs, UT Austin is a national leader in engineering, finance, and entrepreneurship. Its leading blockchain club, Texas Blockchain, and its thriving blockchain community make it the perfect host for UBC 2026.

name: Finding Satoshi: filmvertoning & borrel
description:
Wie is Satoshi Nakamoto? Het is een van de grootste onopgeloste raadsels van onze tijd, en op zaterdag 21 november duiken we er samen in. De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy nodigt je uit voor een besloten vertoning van Finding Satoshi in Flora Filmtheater in Den Haag, met popcorn bij de film en een borrel na afloop

Over de film Finding Satoshi (2026) volgt onderzoeksjournalist William D. Cohan en privédetective Tyler Maroney tijdens een forensisch onderzoek van vier jaar naar de herkomst van Bitcoin. Onderweg spreken ze mensen uit het hart van de sector, onder wie Michael Saylor en Joseph Lubin. De film gaat net zo goed over de ideeën achter Bitcoin als over de vraag wie het heeft bedacht. Regie: Matthew Miele en Tucker Tooley - 101 minuten - Engels gesproke

Wat is inbegrepen Toegang tot de besloten vertoning in de filmzaal van Flora Popcorn bij de film Borrel na afloop met twee drankjes Een middag met Bitcoiners, ondernemers en nieuwsgierigen Popcorn en drankjes worden je aangeboden door onze sponsor Blockrise

Programma 13.30 uur: inloop 14.00 uur: welkom en start film Rond 15.45 uur: einde film Aansluitend: borrel bij Flora, tot ongeveer 17.30 uu

Voor wie Voor iedereen: of je al jaren in Bitcoin zit, net begint of gewoon nieuwsgierig bent. Na de aftiteling praten we verder tijdens de borrel. Neem gerust iemand mee

Praktisch Flora Filmtheater, De Constant Rebecquestraat 55, Den Haag (Regentessekwartier). Openbaar vervoer: RandstadRail 3 en tram 11 op vijf minuten lopen, RandstadRail 4 op tien minuten. Parkeren kan in de wijk en je fiets zet je voor de deur. De film start stipt om 14.00 uur, dus kom op tijd

Tickets Early Bird €35 - Regulier €42 Inclusief film, popcorn en twee drankjes. De zaal telt 50 stoelen, dus wees er op tijd bij

Over de Dutch Bitcoin Embassy De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy brengt ondernemers, bouwers en nieuwsgierigen rond Bitcoin samen in Den Haag. Na de uitverkochte vertoning van DirtyCoin in 2025 is dit onze tweede filmmiddag. We kijken ernaar uit je (weer) te zien. Vragen? Mail info@dutchbitcoinembassy.co

In English Private screening of Finding Satoshi, followed by drinks. Saturday 21 November 2026, doors 13:30, film starts 14:00, Flora Filmtheater, The Hague. The film is in English. Your ticket includes the screening, popcorn and two drinks at the reception afterwards, courtesy of our sponsor Blockrise.

name: Trust Infrastructure for the Tokenization Era : Travel Rule and AML
description: As digital assets transition from pilot experiments (STOs and RWAs) into institutional finance, KYC and AML compliance are no longer merely back-office burdens - they are the core trust infrastructure and prerequisites for new business. Ahead of South Korea's full implementation of the Travel Rule (effective February 2027) - which lowers exemption thresholds and tightens rules on unhosted wallets and cross-border transfers - this seminar brings together regulators, law enforcement, financial institutions, and global tech leaders to bridge statutory requirements with operational industry practice. Event Highlights - Legislative Challenges & Risk Control - Legal issues in the full implementation of the Travel Rule and risk-based control practices for strengthening financial governance - Global Infrastructure & Tech Demonstration - Sumsub's compliance model supporting 2,000+ global clients and a remittance PoC case study integrating foreign national KYC - Public-Private Joint Panel Discussion - Strategies for operationalizing regulatory requirements into industry practice, featuring regulatory authorities, law enforcement, Korean financial institutions, and global experts

name: CyberSwaraj: Nostr, Cryptography Basics & How It Actually Works
description:
A beginner-to-intermediate friendly workshop for anyone curious about real digital privacy. Tired of platforms that own your data, shadow-ban your voice, or can disappear overnight? This hands-on session pulls back the curtain on Nostr - a simple, open protocol for decentralized social networking - and the cryptography that makes it possible. No prior technical background required; just curiosity

What You'll Learn Part 1 - Cryptography Basics (Demystified) - Why privacy isn't "having something to hide" - it's about control - Public vs. private keys: the foundation of digital identity - Hashing, signatures, and encryption - what they do and when to use each - How you already use this technology everyday without realizing it - Common myths about anonymity and what actually protects you Part 2 - What Is Nostr? - The problem Nostr solves: platform lock-in, censorship, and identity fragility - How Nostr works: events, relays, keys, and clients - Your keys = your identity. Your data = portable across apps - Practical setup: create your first identity and post your first note Part 3 - Nostr Technicals (Made Approachable) - Event structure and kinds - the grammar of the protocol - Relays: what they are, how to choose them, and why many is better than one - NIPs (Nostr Implementation Possibilities) - the standards that keep the network compatible - Zap (Lightning payments) basics and why they matter for creators - Security habits: key storage, signing devices, and avoiding common pitfall

Who This Is For - Beginners curious about privacy and decentralized tech - Builders, writers, and creators wanting platform independence - Intermediates who've "heard of Nostr" but never really understood it - Anyone who's lost an account, been shadow-banned, or worries about data ownershi

What You'll Walk Away With - A working Nostr identity and your first published note - A clear mental model of cryptography fundamentals - The confidence to evaluate privacy tools critically - Resources and a community to continue learnin

Format Interactive mini-lecture + live demos + guided setup time + Q&A. Bring a laptop or phone. No coding required to participate; code examples available for the curious. Privacy isn't a feature you buy - it's a skill you build. Come learn it with us

Privacy is not about hiding. Most conversations about privacy start by making you feel paranoid. This one won't. Privacy is something ordinary and human. It's the ability to decide what parts of your life get shared, when they get shared, and with whom. In the physical world this feels obvious. You close the door when you change clothes. You lower your voice in a crowded room. You don't hand your diary to a stranger. Online, we've slowly given up all of that, usually without realising we were giving anything up. Each app asks for a small permission. Each service collects a small piece of information. Individually, none of it feels like much. Put together, it forms a surprisingly complete picture of how you live, think, move, and talk to people you love

What is the 'CyberSwaraj' event series about CyberSwaraj is a gathering for anyone interested in digital privacy, open-source tools, and taking back some control over their digital life. We run sessions for beginners, workshops for people ready to go deeper, and occasional deep-dives for the technically curious. Developers, privacy advocates, and people who've simply had enough of being tracked are all welcome

name: L'écosystème fintech montréalais à l'heure de la tokenisation
description: La tokenisation n'est plus une promesse technologique. Les cadres réglementaires convergent aux États-Unis, en Europe, à Hong Kong et au Canada. Les institutions financières s'organisent en consortiums, et les stablecoins s'imposent progressivement comme de véritables rails de paiement. Montréal possède de solides atouts pour prendre part à cette transformation : un écosystème fintech mature, des talents spécialisés en finance et en technologies numériques, ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue en intelligence artificielle. La métropole bénéficie également d'un savoir-faire concret dans les domaines de la chaîne de blocs, du Web3 et de la DeFi, avec des entreprises et des équipes capables de mener des projets d'envergure au Québec comme à l'international. Lors de cet événement de la communauté CFI, Finance Montréal et T-RIZE présenteront les grandes tendances qui façonnent l'avenir de la finance numérique et discuteront du rôle que le Québec peut jouer dans le développement de l'économie tokenisée. À partir des faits saillants du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et d'une analyse des avancées récentes en matière de tokenisation, nous verrons pourquoi Montréal offre un environnement particulièrement favorable aux initiatives liées aux actifs numériques et aux infrastructures financières de nouvelle génération. Programme 1. Accueil et dîner 2. Présentation du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et portrait de l'écosystème fintech montréalais 3. L'écosystème montréalais de la tokenisation 4. Période de questions et échanges entre pairs Présentateurs - Bruno Séguin, directeur principal, Comptes stratégiques, Finance Montréal - Jean-Luc Pellerin, directeur, Écosystème et partenariats stratégiques, T-RIZE Ce que vous allez retirer de cet événement - Un portrait à jour de l'écosystème fintech montréalais, tiré du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026; - Un tour d'horizon des acteurs qui bâtissent l'infrastructure de tokenisation à Montréal. Un dîner sera servi sur place. L'événement est gratuit, mais les places sont limitées.

name: CWC x Sosoul: A Breathwork Evening
description:
CWC x Sosoul: A Breathwork Evening Two hours, n

:
-, just space to breathe, slow down, and reset with the Crypto Women Collective community. About this event: When the week fills up, the first thing we drop is never the deadline. It's the twenty minutes we promised ourselves, the ones that don't belong to a client, a to-do list, or anyone but us. We thought this would be something for our members: a breathwork session hosted at the beautiful Sosoul Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/). No crypto talk, no networking pressure, just space to reset and be with other women from the community without a

:
- attached. Never done breathwork before? It's a guided practice using conscious breathing patterns to shift your nervous system out of fight-or-flight and into actual rest. No experience needed, you just show up and breathe

:
- Walk in between 19:30 and 20:00, doors close right at 20:00 when the breathwork starts. From there, our guide takes the group through a full breathwork practice designed to release tension you didn't even know you were holding, the kind that sitting still never quite reaches. Come as you are; loose, comfortable clothing helps. Mats and props are provided. Afterward, there's a few quiet minutes to notice how you feel, and time to talk with the person next to you or whoever's in the room, before we close out around 22:00. Your guide: Marieke Lintz (https://www.instagram.com/marieke.breathes/) is a breathwork coach and a CWC member herself. She'll lead the group through the practice and hold space for whatever comes up in the room. Details Thursday 10 December 19:30 doors - 20:00 breathwork starts - 22:00 end Sosoul, Anjeliersstraat 46-H, Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/) €27,50 for CWC members (usually €55) Max 12 spots Not yet part of the Crypto Women Collective? Crypto Women Collective is a growing community of 300+, from complete beginners to people already building careers in the space. This is a community of peers and women who want to know more, learn together and network, all around the topic of crypto and beyond. Become a member (https://tally.so/r/yPYd46) today. FAQ: Do I need any experience with breathwork? No. This session works whether you've never tried it or you do it every week. What should I bring or wear? Comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. Mats and props are provided at the venue. Can I arrive a little later than 19:30? Please don't leave it too late, doors close at 20:00 sharp when the breathwork begins, and once the practice starts we can't let latecomers in without disrupting the group. Good to know Photo & Video: We may take photos and video at this event for our website and social media. Prefer not to be photographed? Just let our team know on arrival. More on how we handle your data in our Privacy & Cookie Policy (https://cryptowomencollective.com/privacy-cookie-policy?utm_source=luma). Refunds: Plans change, we get it. You can cancel for a full refund until 2 December (7 days before the event). After that, we can't refund your ticket. We book and pay for the venue in advance, and with only 12 spots, every seat counts. Can't make it after all? You're welcome to pass your spot on to a friend, just let us know who's coming in your place. If we ever need to cancel, you'll get a full refund. As tickets are for a specific date, the 14-day withdrawal right doesn't apply. Staying in touch: With your ticket, you'll also receive occasional updates about upcoming CWC events. Not for you? Just unsubscribe in any email. By getting a ticket, you agree to our Terms & Conditions. Questions? Reach out at contact@cryptowomencollective.com, we're happy to help.

name: Workshop: Navigating Cyber Threats Across the Onchain Ecosystem
description:
Welcome to The Studio Workshop Series: sessions designed for founders who are building right now. Each workshop takes one skill that directly affects how you fundraise, grow, or ship, and breaks it down into concrete steps you can apply to your own startup. :
- : Doors open 5:30 PM: Workshop 6:30 PM: Networkin

About the workshop Every team building onchain is a target. Attackers move fast, from wallet drainers and fake tokens to exploits that trick users into signing something different from what they saw. The better you understand how these attacks work, the better you can design against them. Join Meg Yodfat and Noah Newfield from Blockaid (https://www.blockaid.io/) to break down the threats hitting builders today and how to stop them. We'll walk through real attack patterns, map them to a security lifecycle for building dApps, from threat modeling and audits to deployment, and show how teams use real-time monitoring and transaction validation to protect protocols and users once they're live. Kenny is also currently a Board Member of Two Sigma Asia. He was formerly Two Sigma Asia's CEO and Chairman of Two Sigma China. Two Sigma is one of world's largest hedge funds. Two Sigma China is the second largest global hedge fund in China.

Earlier in his career, Kenny was Global Partner of McKinsey & Company and a co-leader of its Asia Financial Institutional Practice. Kenny was one of the fastest rising partners ever of McKinsey, elected as a global partner six years from his start as an analyst.

Kenny has a few public roles. He is a Member of the Board of Advisors of The Wharton School,The School's most senior board and was formerly Chairman of the Executive Board of the Wharton School in Asia. He is Vice-Chairman and Trustee of the Asia Pacific Council of The Nature Conservancy. He is Co-Founder and Co-Chairman of Melo Foundation, one of the largest youth empowerment NGOs in Asia.

Kenny graduated with a finance degree from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and a law degree from Oxford University. He was the first ever Chinese to be awarded the Joseph Wharton Scholarship. What Comes Next? The Next Disruption in Asset Management? Asset management has evolved in distinct waves, each driven by structural innovation and enabled by technology: 1770s: Closed-End Funds 1920s: Open-End Mutual Funds 1970s: Index Funds 1990s: ETFs 2020s: A new paradigm emerging: Vaults? Technological innovations in digital trading and programmatic trading gave rise to ETFs in the 1990s, which now account for around $20 trillion in AUM. Technology continues to evolve, and with it comes the next major disruption in asset management. Is the next reinvention of asset management already unfolding before us? The real question is not whether asset management will continue to be reinvented, but which investors will identify the next structural change early enough to benefit from it? CoinDesk's Consensus Miami 2027 is a three-day gathering for participants in crypto, finance, technology and policy. Its announced themes cover crypto at scale, institutional integration and agentic commerce. The current program highlights include a fireside conversation with CZ, a keynote by Michael Saylor, a fireside conversation with Chairman Selig and a session on crypto payment rails and open protocols for agentic commerce. Consult the official program for updated times and speaker details.

Vivek Raman is the Co-Founder and CEO of Etherealize, where he is building the global settlement network for tokenized assets on Ethereum. Etherealize is the only company ever funded by the Ethereum Foundation to serve as its institutional arm, and is backed by Paradigm, Electric Capital, and Vitalik Buterin. Prior to founding Etherealize, Vivek spent fifteen years on Wall Street and in digital assets. He traded high-yield bonds, distressed credit, leveraged loans, and credit default swaps at Morgan Stanley, UBS, Deutsche Bank, and Nomura. He went on to serve as Managing Director and Head of Digital Assets at BitOoda, a regulated digital asset investment bank, and built a real estate portfolio of 100+ homes and land parcels - where the industry's inefficiency drove his interest in blockchain. In June 2025, Vivek testified before the U.S. House Financial Services Committee in support of the CLARITY Act, making the case that decentralized blockchain networks represent critical infrastructure for the next generation of American capital markets. He has also engaged directly with the SEC's Crypto Task Force and serves on the CFTC's Industry Advisory Committee on the regulatory framework for tokenized assets. At Etherealize, Vivek has assembled a team of over thirty spanning Wall Street veterans and Ethereum's most accomplished engineers and has raised $40 million to bring institutional assets fully on-chain. He is a graduate of Yale University, where he studied economics.

description:
Adopting Bitcoin Arnhem focuses on using Bitcoin as money and developing real-world adoption. The organizer has announced May 28-29, 2027, and opened ticket sales. The venue and 2027 speaker programme are still to be announced

Arnhem 2027 Adopting Bitcoin Arnhem is part of the Adopting Bitcoin label which focusses on using bitcoin as money. We are a series of in-person gatherings where Bitcoiners and Bitcoin-curious individuals can connect, learn, and drive real-world Bitcoin adoption. As the longest running local bitcoin economy, Arnhem is proud to host another edition of Adopting Bitcoin Arnhem

Tickets can be paid in Bitcoin only (why?

Speakers TBA Speakers for the Arnhem 2027 edition will be announced in the coming months. Are you a builder in the bitcoin space and want to share your work with peers in the bitcoin space? We are very thankful these cool parties are helping us make it happen! For sponsorship inquiries, organizing side events or general questions about Adopting Bitcoin Arnhem 2027, please write to us. Arnhem "Bitcoinstad" is the worlds longest running local bitcoin economy and started in 2014. Dozens of shops, restaurants and services are accepting bitcoin. Arnhem had the first Burger King accepting bitcoin (2016) and the first SPAR accepting bitcoin (2014) the latter is still accepting bitcoin. You can find them all on BTCMap, but you can also check out the Arnhem Bitcoin City website for more information. Meanwhile... checkout the official website of Arnhem Bitcoin City. Relive the previous edition (2024). And of course see the Adopting Bitcoin website for other Adopting Bitcoin conferences!

description:
The Bridge Between TradFi and Digital Assets. The Institutional Summit for Digital Assets. Paris, July 6-7, 2027

What it is

Signal Week is the summit for the institutional digital-assets sector, set in Paris. It succeeds seven years of Paris Blockchain Week as its elevation for the decade ahead: where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital asset conference, Signal Week positions it for the decade ahead

Audience

The organizer inherits an audience with more than 70% C-suite or investment decision-makers, 36,000-plus facilitated networking meetings, $50 trillion-plus in assets under management represented, and 389 government officials and policymakers. It is built for banking and financial services, asset management, enterprise, digital-asset native firms, traditional finance, infrastructure providers and family offices

Speakers

Past stages have hosted Changpeng Zhao (Binance), Jeremy Allaire (Circle), Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Silvio Micali (Algorand), Charles Hoskinson, Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys), Tim Draper, Jan Van Eck (VanEck), Yoni Assia (eToro) and Arianna Simpson (a16z), alongside French ministers Anne Le Henanff, Clara Chappaz and Marina Ferrari. Featured faces for 2027 include Adam Back, Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock), Kara Kennedy (JP Morgan), Amy Oldenburg (Morgan Stanley), Ben Slavin (BNY), Christian Rau (Mastercard) and Daniel Seifert (Coinbase)

Participation

Participants span digital-asset native builders, TradFi and fintech institutions deploying at scale, AI-for-finance providers and ecosystem partners. Founding partnerships for Signal Week 2027 are open.

description:
Bitcoin Asia returns to Hong Kong on 26-27 August 2027, with the organisers describing it as the meeting point where the exchanges, builders, allocators and the wider Bitcoin community across Asia come together under one roof

Passes The 2027 General Admission pass is listed at $69 and covers two-day access to the Main Stage and Side Stage sessions, the Expo Hall, the Art Gallery hosting Asia's largest Bitcoin digital art showcase, and the official event app for planning the agenda. The General Admission Plus pass is $129 and adds the Deal Flow Zone for one-to-one business meetings, in-app meeting-table booking, BTC+ networking app access, priority Main Stage seating and a dedicated check-in desk. The Whale Pass is $1,499 and includes backstage deep sessions with speakers, all-inclusive food and drinks, access to Whale Night side events and the after-party, The Deep private lounge, priority seating and a VIP gift bag. Groups and companies can request a tailored package

Past speakers Previous editions featured CZ, Balaji Srinivasan (CEO and founder, Network School), Dr Hon Johnny Ng and Kit Chong MH (Hong Kong Legislative Council), David Bailey (CEO and chairman, Nakamoto Inc.), Simon Gerovich (CEO, Metaplanet), Justin Sun (advisor, WBTC), Aj Scaramucci (founder and CEO, Treasure Trove), Jack Kong (founder and board member, Nano Labs and Hong Kong Cyberport), Bonnie Chang (founder and host, Bonnie Blockchain) and Bilal Bin Saqib (chairman, Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority). Bitcoin Asia is published by BTC Inc., a subsidiary of Nakamoto Inc. (NASDAQ: NAKA).
